The Logic here is as follows:

[First Number × second number) ÷ 3] = third number

= [18 × 24 ÷ 3)]

Option (1) (26, 15, 130)

= [26 × 15 ÷ 3)]

= 130 = Third Number

Hence, the correct answer is "(26, 15, 130)".

In (18, 24, 144)

= [18 × 8]

= 144 = Third Number

= [26 × (1 × 5)]

= [26 × 5]

= 130 = Third Number

Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

questions.solution:
Given that:-

78 ÷ 48 × 8 + (26 × 7) – 39 + (45 + 15) = 210

BODMAS rule:-

From option 1:-

26 and 15 interchange:-

78 ÷ 48 × 8 + (15 × 7) – 39 + (45 + 26) = 210

Applying BODMAS rule:-

78 ÷ 48 × 8 + 105 – 39 + 71 = 210

1.625 × 8 + 105 – 39 + 71 = 210

13 + 105 – 39 + 71 = 210

189 – 39 = 210

150 ≠ 210, It is not follow.

From option 2:-

45 and 48 interchange:-

78 ÷ 45 × 8 + (26 × 7) – 39 + (48 + 15) = 210

Applying BODMAS rule:-

78 ÷ 45 × 8 + 182 – 39 + 63 = 210

1.73 × 8 + 182 – 39 + 63 = 210

13.86 + 182 – 39 + 63 = 210

258.86 – 39 = 210

219.86 ≠ 210, It is not follow.

From option 3:-

48 and 39 interchange:-

78 ÷ 39 × 8 + (26 × 7) – 48 + (45 + 15) = 210

Applying BODMAS rule:-

78 ÷ 39 × 8 + 182 – 48 + 60 = 210

2 × 8 + 182 – 48 + 60 = 210

16 + 182 – 48 + 60 = 210

258 – 48 = 210

210 = 210, It is follow.

From option 4:-

78 and 45 interchange:-

45 ÷ 48 × 8 + (26 × 7) – 39 + (78 + 15) = 210

Applying BODMAS rule:-

45 ÷ 48 × 8 + 182 – 39 + 93 = 210

0.93 × 8 + 182 – 39 + 93 = 210

82.5 + 182 – 39 + 93 = 210

357.5 – 39 = 210

318.5 ≠ 210, It is not follow.

Hence, "option 3" is the correct answer.

Additional Information

    • Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956 (IPR 1956) is a resolution adopted by the Indian Parliament in April 1956.
    • It was the first comprehensive statement on the industrial development of India. 
    • It was regarded as the “Economic Constitution of India” or “The Bible of State Capitalism”.
    • The government revised its first Industrial Policy (i.e.the policy of 1948) through the Industrial Policy of 1956.
    • The 1956 Policy empha­sised the need to expand the public sector, to build up a large and growing coop­erative sector and to encourage the separation of ownership and management in private in­dustries and, above all, prevent the rise of pri­vate monopolies.
    • It provided the basic framework for the government’s policy regarding in­dustries till June 1991.

questions.question: The cost of tiling the floor of a rectangular room is Rs. 9100 at Rs. 65 per m 2 . The ratio of the length and breadth of the floor is 7 ∶ 5. The perimeter (in m) of the floor of the room is:
questions.questionHtml: The cost of tiling the floor of a rectangular room is Rs. 9100 at Rs. 65 per m<sup>2</sup>. The ratio of the length and breadth of the floor is 7 ∶ 5. The perimeter (in m) of the floor of the room is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Area of the floor = 9100 ÷ 65 = 140 m2.

Ratio of Length : Breadth = 7 : 5 → Product of parts = 7 × 5 = 35 units2.

35 units2 = 140 ⇒ 1 unit2 = 4 ⇒ 1 unit = 2 m.

Perimeter = 2 × (7 + 5) = 24 units.

Perimeter = 24 × 2 = 48 m.

∴ The correct answer is 48 m.

Alternate Method

Given:

Total cost of tiling = ₹9100

Rate of tiling = ₹65 per m2

Ratio of Length (L) and Breadth (B) = 7 : 5

Formula Used:

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

Calculations:

⇒ Area of the floor = Total cost ÷ Rate

⇒ Area = 9100 ÷ 65 = 140 m2

⇒ Let Length = 7x and Breadth = 5x

⇒ 7x × 5x = 140

⇒ 35x2 = 140

⇒ x2 = 140 ÷ 35 = 4

⇒ x = √4 = 2

⇒ Length = 7 × 2 = 14 m

⇒ Breadth = 5 × 2 = 10 m

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (14 + 10) = 2 × 24 = 48 m

∴ The correct answer is 48 m.

Additional Information

Area and Perimeter relationship

For a given area, a square has the minimum perimeter among all rectangles. Area = a2 and Perimeter = 4a.

Cost of Fencing

The cost of fencing a rectangular field is calculated based on its perimeter. Cost = Perimeter × Rate per meter.

Diagonal of Rectangle

The diagonal (d) of a rectangular room is given by d = √(Length2 + Breadth2).

Given:

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral

∠AEB = 27°

Concept used:

Sum of opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180° 

Sum of linear pair of angles of is always 180° 

Sum of all 3 interior angles of triangle is 180° 

Calculation:

∠BAE + ∠BEA + ∠ABE = 180° 

⇒ 68° + 27° + ∠ABE = 180° 

⇒ 95° + ∠ABE = 180° 

⇒ ∠ABE = (180° – 95°)

⇒ ∠ABE = 85° 

Now,

∠ABE + ∠CBF = 180° [linear pair]

⇒ 85° + ∠CBF = 180° 

⇒ ∠CBF = (180° – 85°)

⇒ ∠CBF = 95° 

Now,

∠BAE + ∠BCD = 180°  [opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral]

⇒ 68° + ∠BCD = 180° 

⇒ ∠BCD = (180° – 68°)

⇒ ∠BCD = 112° 

Now,

∠BCD + ∠BCF = 180° [linear pair]

⇒ 112° + ∠BCF = 180° 

⇒ ∠BCF = (180° – 112°)

⇒ ∠BCF = 68°

In ΔBCF

⇒ 163° + ∠BFC = 180° 

⇒ ∠BFC = (180° – 163°)

⇒ ∠BFC = 17° 

∴ The required value is 17°

questions.question: If 5 sin 2 θ - 4 cos θ - 4 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (cot θ + cosec θ) is:
questions.questionHtml: If 5 sin<sup>2</sup> θ - 4 cos θ - 4 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (cot θ + cosec θ) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

5sin2θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

Formula used:

sin2θ = 1 – cos2θ 

P2 = (H2 – B2)

Cotθ = B/P

Cosecθ = H/P

Calculation:

 5sin2θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5(1 – cos2θ) – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5 – 5cos2θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5cos2θ + 4cosθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 5cos2θ + 5cosθ – cosθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 5cosθ(cosθ + 1) – 1(cosθ + 1) = 0

⇒ (5cosθ – 1) (cosθ + 1) = 0

⇒ cosθ = 1/5 or -1

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ P2 = (H2 – B2)

⇒ P2 = (52 – 12)

⇒ P2 =(25 – 1)

⇒ P2 = 24

⇒ P = 2√6

Now,

Cotθ = B/P = 1/2√6

Cosecθ = H/P = 5/2√6

(cot θ + cosec θ) = (1/2√6 + 5/2√6)

⇒ (6/2√6)

⇒ (3/√6)

Multiplying the conjugate of √6 to numerator and denominator, we get

⇒ (3/√6 × √6/√6)

⇒ ( 3√6/6)

⇒ √6/2

∴ The required value is √6/2

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 3125 amounts to Rs. 3515.20 in 3 years at x% p.a., interest being compounded yearly. What will be the simple interest (in Rs.) on the same sum and for the same time at (x + 2)% p.a.?
questions.questionHtml: A sum of Rs. 3125 amounts to Rs. 3515.20 in 3 years at x% p.a., interest being compounded yearly. What will be the simple interest (in Rs.) on the same sum and for the same time at (x + 2)% p.a.?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

For 3 years, the ratio of (Amount / Principal)1/3 gives (1 + r/100).

⇒ √3(3515.20 / 3125) = √3(35152 / 31250) = √3(17576 / 15625) = 26/25.

Rate x = (1 / 25) × 100 = 4%.

New rate = 4% + 2% = 6%.

Simple Interest = 3125 × 6% × 3 = 3125 × 0.18 = ₹562.50.

∴ The correct answer is ₹562.50.

Alternate Method

Given: Principal (P) = ₹3125, Amount (A) = ₹3515.20, Time (T) = 3 years.

Formula Used: A = P(1 + r/100)n and SI = (P × R × T) / 100.

Step 1: Calculate the value of x

⇒ 3515.20 = 3125(1 + x/100)3

⇒ 3515.20 / 3125 = (1 + x/100)3

⇒ 351520 / 312500 = (1 + x/100)3

⇒ 17576 / 15625 = (1 + x/100)3

⇒ (26/25)3 = (1 + x/100)3

⇒ 1 + x/100 = 26/25

⇒ x/100 = 26/25 − 1 = 1/25

⇒ x = 100 / 25 = 4%

Step 2: Calculate Simple Interest

⇒ New Rate = (x + 2)% = 4 + 2 = 6% p.a.

⇒ SI = (3125 × 6 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = (3125 × 18) / 100

⇒ SI = 56250 / 100 = 562.50

∴ The correct answer is ₹562.50.

Additional Information

Compound Interest Formula

The total amount A = P(1 + r/100)n, where P is Principal, r is Rate, and n is Time in years.

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest Difference

For 2 years, the difference is D = P(r/100)2. For 3 years, D = P(r/100)2 × (3 + r/100).

Effective Rate of Interest

In CI, the effective rate for 2 years is x + y + (xy/100). For SI, the effective rate is simply Rate × Time.

questions.question: The income of A is 20% less than the income of B and the income of C is 70% of the sum of incomes of A and B. The income of D is 25% more than the income of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is Rs. 23000, then what is the income (in Rs.) of A?
questions.questionHtml: The income of A is 20% less than the income of B and the income of C is 70% of the sum of incomes of A and B. The income of D is 25% more than the income of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is Rs. 23000, then what is the income (in Rs.) of A?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Let Income of B = 100 units, then A = 80 units (20% less).

Income of C = 70% of (100 + 80) = 126 units.

Income of D = 125% of 126 = 157.5 units.

Difference (D − B) = 57.5 units → ₹23000 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹400.

Income of A = 80 × 400 = ₹32000.

∴ The correct answer is ₹32000.

Alternate Method

Given:

Income of A = Income of B − 20% of Income of B

Income of C = 70% of (Income of A + Income of B)

Income of D = Income of C + 25% of Income of C

Difference between incomes of B and D = ₹23000

Calculations:

⇒ Let the income of B = 100x

⇒ Income of A = 100x − 20x = 80x

⇒ Income of C = 70% of (80x + 100x) = 126x

⇒ Income of D = 126x + 25% of 126x = 157.5x

⇒ Difference between D and B = 157.5x − 100x = 57.5x

⇒ 57.5x = 23000

⇒ x = 23000 ÷ 57.5

⇒ x = 400

⇒ Income of A = 80x = 80 × 400 = 32000

∴ The correct answer is ₹32000.

Additional Information

Base Value in Percentage

When comparing two quantities, the quantity following words like 'than' or 'of' is generally taken as the base (100%).

Successive Percentage Change

If a value is changed by A% and then by B%, the net percentage change is given by A + B + (A × B) ÷ 100.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

It is helpful to remember standard fraction equivalents, such as 20% = 1/5 and 25% = 1/4, for faster calculations.

⇒ 4s = 27

⇒ s = (27/4)

⇒ s = \(6\frac{3}{4}\) km/h

Given:

Concept used:

Divisibility rule of 3 - If sum of all digit of number is divisible by 3 then whole number is divisible by 3.

Divisibility rule of 7 - To make a pair of 3 from unit digit than subtract left over pair,

The result is divisible by 7.

Divisibility rule of 11 - Sum of odd digit place – Sum of even digit place = 0 or multiple of 11.

Calculation:

688xy is divisible by 3, 7 and 11

For divisibility rule of 3, (x + y) = 2, 5, 8, 11

For divisibility rule of 11, (6 + 8 + y) – (8 + x) = 0 or 11

⇒ (14 + y) – (8 + x) = 0 or 11

We take the value of y = 8 or x = 3

⇒ (14 + 8) – (8 + 3) = 0 or 11

⇒ (22 – 11) = 11 [divisible by 11]

So, the value of x = 3 and y = 8

Now,

(5x + 3y) = (5 × 3 + 3 × 8)

⇒ (15 + 24)

⇒ 39

∴ The required value is 39

questions.question: A can complete a work in 60 days. B is 25% more efficient than A. They work together for 15 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 14 days. B and C together will complete \(\frac{5}{8}\) th part of the original work in:
questions.questionHtml: A can complete a work in 60 days. B is 25% more efficient than A. They work together for 15 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 14 days. B and C together will complete \(\frac{5}{8}\)th part of the original work in:
questions.solution:
Given:

Time taken to complete a work by A = 60 days

B is 25% more efficient than A 

(A + B) worked together = 15 days

Time taken to complete the remaining work by C = 14 days

Formula used:

Work = Efficiency × Time

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of A be x

B is 25% more efficient than A

⇒ (25/100)x = 1x/4

Efficient of A = 4

Efficient of B = (4 + 1) = 5

Total work = (4 × 60) = 240 units

A and B worked together for 15 days = [(5 + 4) × 15]

⇒ (9 × 15) = 135 units

Remaining work = (240 – 135) = 105 units

Time taken to complete the remaining work by C = (105/14) 

⇒ 15/2 = 7.5

Time taken by B and C to complete the 5/8th part of original work = [240/(5 + 7.5) × 5/8]

⇒ (240/12.5 × 5/8)

⇒ (6 × 2)

⇒ 12 days

∴ The required time is 12 days

Shortcut Trick

So, total efficiency of A and B = 9

In 15 days work of A + B = 9 × 15 = 135 units

Remaining (240 - 135) = 105 units will complete by C in 14 days

So, C in one day = 7.5 units

Time taken by B and C to complete the 5/8th part of original work = [240/(5 + 7.5) × 5/8] = 12 days
